result.title: MoCA4D: Monocular 3D Bounding Box Lifting and Tracking with Camera and Object Motion
result.summary: Monocular 3D bounding box tracking must account for both object motion and changes in camera viewpoint. Framewise box lifting with temporal filtering leaves these motion components implicit, while static-scene fusion assumes stationary objects. We introduce MoCA4D, a framework for 3D box lifting and tracking from monocular video, associated 2D box prompts, and camera intrinsics. An observation branch estimates per-frame geometry, while a dynamic branch predicts a camera transformation shared across objects and a separate rigid transformation for each object. We propose Star Optimization to refine current depth and orientation using the observation and historical boxes propagated through these transformations. The refined box then guides subsequent propagation. Across all evaluated objects in Argoverse 2 and ADT, Star Optimization reduces center motion error by 38.1% and 38.7%, respectively, relative to Kalman filtering of the same observations. On MOVi-F, the dynamic branch achieves the lowest corner and rotation errors and the highest IoU among the evaluated methods over eight-transition motion windows. Real-data camera-only controls further link predicted object motion to improved localization on dynamic-object tracks.

AI.brief_summary: MoCA4D 从单目视频、2D 框提示与相机内参出发做 3D 框提升与跟踪：观测分支逐帧估计几何，动态分支分别预测跨物体共享的相机变换与每个物体的刚体变换，再用 Star Optimization 借历史框传播精修当前深度与朝向，精修结果反过来指导后续传播。
AI.relevance_reason: 把运动显式分解为共享视角变化与逐物体刚性变化、并用历史状态迭代精修当前估计的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态的更新方式以及将视角与内容因素分离；但它属几何跟踪任务，与视觉推理主线距离较远，迁移性需自行判断。
